I checked your transactions, and the StreamFlix charge of **$15.00** is already marked as **refunded**. Its note says it was refunded on November 18, 2026. Our policy doesn't allow a second refund on the same transaction, so I haven't issued one.

If you still see the $15.00 charge missing from your refund, or you were charged by StreamFlix more than once, tell me the details. I can look for any other StreamFlix charges on your account. If the refund never reached you, that would need to be looked into further, and I can't open that investigation from here.
